hazards.evidence: Pet food bowl filled with kibble and a rope chew toy sitting on the floor in the middle of the kitchen walkway, directly in a walker's path.
Large dark loose mat/rug with a raised edge lying on the floor in the foreground walkway; edges can catch a walker or foot.
Pots and pans stored low in the under-sink base cabinet (doors open), requiring deep bending to retrieve everyday cookware.
Everyday dishes/bowls kept in high wall cabinets (including the glass-front cabinet) above the counter, requiring overhead reaching while on a walker.
Bare bright pendant bulb at eye line toward the kitchen plus strong window backlight creates glare and high contrast with the dim foreground.
